tigerweb-county-interiors-2026.method: Exact official CDP polygon interior intersects official county interior (esriSpatialRelRelation T********); used only for 13 GEOIDs absent from the 2020 crosswalk.

scope: Every California and Arizona incorporated city/town and Census-designated place in the 2026 Census Gazetteer. Census places do not include every neighborhood, postal city name, or informal community. This registry is geography, not housing inventory.
pointMeaning: internalPoint comes from Census INTPTLAT/INTPTLONG: an internal representative point for geographic discovery, not a geometric centroid or a property address.
countyLimitation: 2,076 records use the official 2020 place-by-county crosswalk, joined by stable GEOID; these county relationships have not all been reverified against 2026 boundaries. The 13 new California CDPs use official January 1, 2026 TIGERweb polygon-interior relationships. Multiple counties are retained.
